reasons.text: The Tigers’ unbeaten start to the new campaign continued at Stamford Bridge despite conceding their first league goals of the season as they turned around an early deficit thanks to Mohamed Belloumi’s quick-fire first half double, although João Pedro would go on to net a second half leveller for the hosts.

2 Hull Stats: João Pedro Adds Another Goal and Assist But Hull Still Maintain Unbeaten Start | Opta Analyst Mohamed Belloumi gave Hull City a surprise advantage at Stamford Bridge, but João Pedro’s second-half goal earned a draw for Chelsea João Pedro salvaged a point with a second-half equaliser, but Chelsea were held in another chaotic contest on Saturday, drawing 2-2 with Hull City.

reasons.text: Just minutes before Guimaraes scored for Arsenal in the second half, goalkeeper Raya stopped Sunderland from going ahead from the penalty spot.
The likes of David Raya, Declan Rice and Bruno Fernandes were shoo-ins in their respective roles, and so too was Jurrien Timber at right-back.
The Gunners would have been 1-0 down after 56 minutes, had David Raya (£6.0m) not earned his crust with a superb penalty save.
Up stepped Enzo Le Fee (£5.8m), for the second week running, but the Frenchman saw his effort excellently tipped against the post by Raya.
Arsenal summer signing Bruno Guimaraes has lauded goalkeeper David Raya after Saturday’s 2-0 win against Sunderland.
However, it was far from easy for Arsenal, with Raya saving a penalty before Guimaraes broke the deadlock with a great strike a few minutes later.
Enzo Le Fee stepped up to take the penalty, but Arsenal and Spain international goalkeeper Raya saved it with a superb save low to his left.

The Black Cats had an opportunity to take the lead early in the second half, but Enzo Le Fée’s penalty was saved by David Raya before Bruno Guimarães opened the scoring for the visitors moments later.
David Raya’s penalty save and a stunning goal from former Newcastle United midfielder Bruno Guimarães proved crucial as Arsenal beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Stadium of Light.

It was Guimarães who made the breakthrough with a curling strike into the top-right corner in the 58 minute, only 121 seconds after Raya had brilliantly turned Enzo Le Feé’s spot-kick against the post.

But he was left angry with the fact that Raya had to save a penalty in the first place, as Arteta felt Daniel Ballard used a ‘judo roll’ to win a penalty off Ezri Konsa as Arsenal were penalized for physical play in the box.

“They could’ve changed the game.” Bruno Guimaraes came off the bench and slammed the Gunners in front, moments after Sunderland saw a penalty saved by Raya, and Guimaraes was asked whether Raya was the best keeper in the world.
David Raya has started 2026/27 where he left off last season, while three new signings feature among the top 10 Premier League goalkeepers.
The location of Morgan Rogers' volley was as significant as the fact that it beat Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya.
It's not easy to score against a goalkeeper of Raya's quality from wider angles.

David Raya FPL: Is Arsenal's £6.0m GK Worth It? | OneFPL Loading OneFPL page In this article sections The short answer David Raya (£6.0m) strengthened his case as FPL's premium goalkeeper with a penalty save and clean sheet at Sunderland.

Among their headline additions are centre-back Nobel Mendy from Rayo Vallecano, goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis from Olympiacos and forward Ilyas Ansah from Union Berlin.

The Gunners would have been 1-0 down after 56 minutes, had David Raya (£6.0m) not earned his crust with a superb penalty save.
Up stepped Enzo Le Fee (£5.8m), for the second week running, but the Frenchman saw his effort excellently tipped against the post by Raya.
Arsenal summer signing Bruno Guimaraes has lauded goalkeeper David Raya after Saturday’s 2-0 win against Sunderland.
However, it was far from easy for Arsenal, with Raya saving a penalty before Guimaraes broke the deadlock with a great strike a few minutes later.
Enzo Le Fee stepped up to take the penalty, but Arsenal and Spain international goalkeeper Raya saved it with a superb save low to his left.

The Black Cats had an opportunity to take the lead early in the second half, but Enzo Le Fée’s penalty was saved by David Raya before Bruno Guimarães opened the scoring for the visitors moments later.
David Raya’s penalty save and a stunning goal from former Newcastle United midfielder Bruno Guimarães proved crucial as Arsenal beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Stadium of Light.

It was Guimarães who made the breakthrough with a curling strike into the top-right corner in the 58 minute, only 121 seconds after Raya had brilliantly turned Enzo Le Feé’s spot-kick against the post.

But he was left angry with the fact that Raya had to save a penalty in the first place, as Arteta felt Daniel Ballard used a ‘judo roll’ to win a penalty off Ezri Konsa as Arsenal were penalized for physical play in the box.

“They could’ve changed the game.” Bruno Guimaraes came off the bench and slammed the Gunners in front, moments after Sunderland saw a penalty saved by Raya, and Guimaraes was asked whether Raya was the best keeper in the world.
David Raya has started 2026/27 where he left off last season, while three new signings feature among the top 10 Premier League goalkeepers.
The location of Morgan Rogers' volley was as significant as the fact that it beat Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya.
It's not easy to score against a goalkeeper of Raya's quality from wider angles.

reasons.text: Just minutes before Guimaraes scored for Arsenal in the second half, goalkeeper Raya stopped Sunderland from going ahead from the penalty spot.
The likes of David Raya, Declan Rice and Bruno Fernandes were shoo-ins in their respective roles, and so too was Jurrien Timber at right-back.
The Gunners would have been 1-0 down after 56 minutes, had David Raya (£6.0m) not earned his crust with a superb penalty save.
Up stepped Enzo Le Fee (£5.8m), for the second week running, but the Frenchman saw his effort excellently tipped against the post by Raya.
Arsenal summer signing Bruno Guimaraes has lauded goalkeeper David Raya after Saturday’s 2-0 win against Sunderland.
However, it was far from easy for Arsenal, with Raya saving a penalty before Guimaraes broke the deadlock with a great strike a few minutes later.
Enzo Le Fee stepped up to take the penalty, but Arsenal and Spain international goalkeeper Raya saved it with a superb save low to his left.

The Black Cats had an opportunity to take the lead early in the second half, but Enzo Le Fée’s penalty was saved by David Raya before Bruno Guimarães opened the scoring for the visitors moments later.
David Raya’s penalty save and a stunning goal from former Newcastle United midfielder Bruno Guimarães proved crucial as Arsenal beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Stadium of Light.

It was Guimarães who made the breakthrough with a curling strike into the top-right corner in the 58 minute, only 121 seconds after Raya had brilliantly turned Enzo Le Feé’s spot-kick against the post.

But he was left angry with the fact that Raya had to save a penalty in the first place, as Arteta felt Daniel Ballard used a ‘judo roll’ to win a penalty off Ezri Konsa as Arsenal were penalized for physical play in the box.

“They could’ve changed the game.” Bruno Guimaraes came off the bench and slammed the Gunners in front, moments after Sunderland saw a penalty saved by Raya, and Guimaraes was asked whether Raya was the best keeper in the world.
David Raya has started 2026/27 where he left off last season, while three new signings feature among the top 10 Premier League goalkeepers.
The location of Morgan Rogers' volley was as significant as the fact that it beat Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya.
It's not easy to score against a goalkeeper of Raya's quality from wider angles.

reasons.text: Just minutes before Guimaraes scored for Arsenal in the second half, goalkeeper Raya stopped Sunderland from going ahead from the penalty spot.
The likes of David Raya, Declan Rice and Bruno Fernandes were shoo-ins in their respective roles, and so too was Jurrien Timber at right-back.
The Gunners would have been 1-0 down after 56 minutes, had David Raya (£6.0m) not earned his crust with a superb penalty save.
Up stepped Enzo Le Fee (£5.8m), for the second week running, but the Frenchman saw his effort excellently tipped against the post by Raya.
Arsenal summer signing Bruno Guimaraes has lauded goalkeeper David Raya after Saturday’s 2-0 win against Sunderland.
However, it was far from easy for Arsenal, with Raya saving a penalty before Guimaraes broke the deadlock with a great strike a few minutes later.
Enzo Le Fee stepped up to take the penalty, but Arsenal and Spain international goalkeeper Raya saved it with a superb save low to his left.

The Black Cats had an opportunity to take the lead early in the second half, but Enzo Le Fée’s penalty was saved by David Raya before Bruno Guimarães opened the scoring for the visitors moments later.
David Raya’s penalty save and a stunning goal from former Newcastle United midfielder Bruno Guimarães proved crucial as Arsenal beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Stadium of Light.

It was Guimarães who made the breakthrough with a curling strike into the top-right corner in the 58 minute, only 121 seconds after Raya had brilliantly turned Enzo Le Feé’s spot-kick against the post.

But he was left angry with the fact that Raya had to save a penalty in the first place, as Arteta felt Daniel Ballard used a ‘judo roll’ to win a penalty off Ezri Konsa as Arsenal were penalized for physical play in the box.

“They could’ve changed the game.” Bruno Guimaraes came off the bench and slammed the Gunners in front, moments after Sunderland saw a penalty saved by Raya, and Guimaraes was asked whether Raya was the best keeper in the world.
David Raya has started 2026/27 where he left off last season, while three new signings feature among the top 10 Premier League goalkeepers.
The location of Morgan Rogers' volley was as significant as the fact that it beat Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya.
It's not easy to score against a goalkeeper of Raya's quality from wider angles.

reasons.text: Just minutes before Guimaraes scored for Arsenal in the second half, goalkeeper Raya stopped Sunderland from going ahead from the penalty spot.
The likes of David Raya, Declan Rice and Bruno Fernandes were shoo-ins in their respective roles, and so too was Jurrien Timber at right-back.
The Gunners would have been 1-0 down after 56 minutes, had David Raya (£6.0m) not earned his crust with a superb penalty save.
Up stepped Enzo Le Fee (£5.8m), for the second week running, but the Frenchman saw his effort excellently tipped against the post by Raya.
Arsenal summer signing Bruno Guimaraes has lauded goalkeeper David Raya after Saturday’s 2-0 win against Sunderland.
However, it was far from easy for Arsenal, with Raya saving a penalty before Guimaraes broke the deadlock with a great strike a few minutes later.
Enzo Le Fee stepped up to take the penalty, but Arsenal and Spain international goalkeeper Raya saved it with a superb save low to his left.

The Black Cats had an opportunity to take the lead early in the second half, but Enzo Le Fée’s penalty was saved by David Raya before Bruno Guimarães opened the scoring for the visitors moments later.
David Raya’s penalty save and a stunning goal from former Newcastle United midfielder Bruno Guimarães proved crucial as Arsenal beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Stadium of Light.

It was Guimarães who made the breakthrough with a curling strike into the top-right corner in the 58 minute, only 121 seconds after Raya had brilliantly turned Enzo Le Feé’s spot-kick against the post.

But he was left angry with the fact that Raya had to save a penalty in the first place, as Arteta felt Daniel Ballard used a ‘judo roll’ to win a penalty off Ezri Konsa as Arsenal were penalized for physical play in the box.

“They could’ve changed the game.” Bruno Guimaraes came off the bench and slammed the Gunners in front, moments after Sunderland saw a penalty saved by Raya, and Guimaraes was asked whether Raya was the best keeper in the world.
David Raya has started 2026/27 where he left off last season, while three new signings feature among the top 10 Premier League goalkeepers.
The location of Morgan Rogers' volley was as significant as the fact that it beat Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya.
It's not easy to score against a goalkeeper of Raya's quality from wider angles.

David Raya FPL: Is Arsenal's £6.0m GK Worth It? | OneFPL Loading OneFPL page In this article sections The short answer David Raya (£6.0m) strengthened his case as FPL's premium goalkeeper with a penalty save and clean sheet at Sunderland.

reasons.text: Just minutes before Guimaraes scored for Arsenal in the second half, goalkeeper Raya stopped Sunderland from going ahead from the penalty spot.
The likes of David Raya, Declan Rice and Bruno Fernandes were shoo-ins in their respective roles, and so too was Jurrien Timber at right-back.
The Gunners would have been 1-0 down after 56 minutes, had David Raya (£6.0m) not earned his crust with a superb penalty save.
Up stepped Enzo Le Fee (£5.8m), for the second week running, but the Frenchman saw his effort excellently tipped against the post by Raya.
Arsenal summer signing Bruno Guimaraes has lauded goalkeeper David Raya after Saturday’s 2-0 win against Sunderland.
However, it was far from easy for Arsenal, with Raya saving a penalty before Guimaraes broke the deadlock with a great strike a few minutes later.
Enzo Le Fee stepped up to take the penalty, but Arsenal and Spain international goalkeeper Raya saved it with a superb save low to his left.

The Black Cats had an opportunity to take the lead early in the second half, but Enzo Le Fée’s penalty was saved by David Raya before Bruno Guimarães opened the scoring for the visitors moments later.
David Raya’s penalty save and a stunning goal from former Newcastle United midfielder Bruno Guimarães proved crucial as Arsenal beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Stadium of Light.

It was Guimarães who made the breakthrough with a curling strike into the top-right corner in the 58 minute, only 121 seconds after Raya had brilliantly turned Enzo Le Feé’s spot-kick against the post.

But he was left angry with the fact that Raya had to save a penalty in the first place, as Arteta felt Daniel Ballard used a ‘judo roll’ to win a penalty off Ezri Konsa as Arsenal were penalized for physical play in the box.

“They could’ve changed the game.” Bruno Guimaraes came off the bench and slammed the Gunners in front, moments after Sunderland saw a penalty saved by Raya, and Guimaraes was asked whether Raya was the best keeper in the world.
David Raya has started 2026/27 where he left off last season, while three new signings feature among the top 10 Premier League goalkeepers.
The location of Morgan Rogers' volley was as significant as the fact that it beat Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya.
It's not easy to score against a goalkeeper of Raya's quality from wider angles.
